# Agent Lifecycle Kit

> Autonomous AI Agent Architecture & Governance Framework for Cursor, Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Windsurf, and GitHub Copilot.

## Core Features
- Hexagonal Architecture (Ports & Adapters) & DDD domain invariant enforcement
- TDD Short Loops & Quality Guardrails
- 20+ specialized lifecycle role skills (agent-spec, agent-tdd, agent-security, agent-arch-drift, agent-telemetry)
- Language & framework profiles (TypeScript, Rust, Go, Python, Java, C#, Next.js, React, Express, Spring Boot)
- Unified kit CLI for application bootstrapping and automated security/eval auditing
- Eval-Driven Development (EDD) harness: `kit eval run|watch|report|ci` with YAML suites, JSONL datasets, OTel spans, and CI threshold gates
